name: Gakkou no Kyaa! ~Sennichi Gakuen Shinbunbu no Teinou Kaiki Eigateki Sekai~
original_name: 学校のきゃあ！～千日学園新聞部の低能怪奇映画的世界～
source:
School yellow pages newspaper covers psychic phenomena and strange cases inside and outside the school. It has a colorful cast. Main character is sent as a spy to this school club. Is it possible for a normal person to compete against monsters and conspiracies that await him in the evenings?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学校黄页报刊登着校内外的灵异现象与奇异案件，成员阵容也个个性格鲜明。主人公被派去这所学校的社团当卧底。面对夜晚等待着他的怪物与阴谋，一个普通人能否与之抗衡？
